clean_repro.observed: HTTP 400 with body {"status":{"error":"Wrong input: Not existing vector name error: "},"time":0.004890318}

contract_refs: constraint_id: qdrant_type_upsert_points_003 - 'vector type is array of floats or object of named vectors'
constraint_id: qdrant_state_upsert_points_004 - 'Batch upsert is atomic: all points are inserted or none'

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: upsert request -> unnamed vector array -> only_default_vector converts to DEFAULT_VECTOR_NAME -> check_vector_name -> get_vector_config_or_error -> vector_data.get(DEFAULT_VECTOR_NAME) fails on empty vectors config -> vector_name_not_exists error
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现: 当 collection 的 vectors 配置为空 {} 时，upsert 传入无名向量数组会被内部转换为 DEFAULT_VECTOR_NAME，但 check_vector_name 在 vector_data HashMap 中找不到该 key，导致抛出 VectorNameNotExists 错误。contract 声明 'vector type is array of floats or object of named vectors' 但未明确说明空 vectors 配置下无名向量应被拒绝还是自动推断维度。

falsification.probe: Repeated upsert with wait=true consistently returns HTTP 400 'Not existing vector name error: '; without wait=true returns HTTP 200 'acknowledged' but point is never stored (points_count=0, retrieval returns 'Point with id 1 does not exists!')
falsification.observed: Error is deterministic and reproducible. Async upsert (wait=false) silently fails without storing the point, masking the validation error.

cognition_match.note: 命中 developer_cognition.blindspot_indicators 中的 'Parameter validation on filter/condition APIs' 模式。虽然这是 vector 而非 filter 参数，但同属 request parsing 层的参数校验盲点。

verdicts.rationale: 源码接地证实：upsert API 允许传入无名向量数组（符合 contract 'array of floats'），但在 collection 的 vectors 配置为空 {} 时，内部将其转换为 DEFAULT_VECTOR_NAME 后无法通过 check_vector_name 校验，抛出 'Not existing vector name error: '。这是真实的参数验证缺失：API 应在更早的请求解析阶段明确拒绝无法匹配到 vector config 的请求，而非在深层 segment 校验阶段失败。contract 声明支持无名向量但未说明其在空 vectors 配置下的预期行为，属于契约模糊 + 实现不一致。
